name: SynthMPDGenerator
what_it_holds: A program for generating synthetic mobile positioning data (MPD), from the same Estonian/Tartu mobile-positioning research cluster as popFlowEstonia and MPDSamplingStatistics. No real data; generates synthetic test data for MPD-based methods.
why_useful: Marginal utility — could help validate an MPD-occupancy-proxy pipeline before real data is sourced, but produces no real signal itself.
themes: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
why_all: Marginal utility — could help validate an MPD-occupancy-proxy pipeline before real data is sourced, but produces no real signal itself.
Useful only for testing an MNO-tourism-proxy pipeline before real data is available; not itself a data source.

name: Positium-Data-Platform
what_it_holds: A modular, Dockerized pipeline (Spark for compression, PostGIS for spatial joins, Flask REST API) for processing 'mobile event data' into hourly-event counts, user-movement, and population-distribution outputs — an independent reimplementation of the Positium-style MNO data pipeline (Positium is Eurostat's MNO tourism-statistics pilot contractor). No data committed; needs a raw mobile-event feed to run.
why_useful: Gives working, inspectable code for exactly the kind of MNO event-to-population-distribution pipeline Eurostat's experimental tourism series is built on, useful if the team ever gets access to any roaming/CDR feed (even a small national one) to nowcast visitor presence.
themes: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
why_all: Gives working, inspectable code for exactly the kind of MNO event-to-population-distribution pipeline Eurostat's experimental tourism series is built on, useful if the team ever gets access to any roaming/CDR feed (even a small national one) to nowcast visitor presence.

name: eurostat/statistics-coded
what_it_holds: Official Eurostat-org catalogue (41 stars) of R/Python/SQL/SAS/Stata code snippets that reproduce the charts/tables behind Eurostat 'Statistics Explained' articles -- some of these articles cover tourism, the collaborative economy, and short-stay accommodation.
why_useful: If any Statistics Explained article on platform/collaborative-economy tourism has reproducible code here, it gives a documented, exact recipe for rebuilding the Eurostat-Airbnb data-sharing-agreement output tables (tour_ce_omr and siblings) rather than reverse-engineering the API from scratch.
duplicate_of_holding: points to the same tour_ce_omr family already held
themes: Country-level Airbnb studies with shared data: OECD/EU/UN reports with data appendices on platform tourism, Eurostat-Airbnb data-sharing agreement outputs, ECB/IMF papers
why_all: If any Statistics Explained article on platform/collaborative-economy tourism has reproducible code here, it gives a documented, exact recipe for rebuilding the Eurostat-Airbnb data-sharing-agreement output tables (tour_ce_omr and siblings) rather than reverse-engineering the API from scratch.

name: expersso/OECD
what_it_holds: R package (145 stars, 66 commits) wrapping the OECD Data Explorer / SDMX API for programmatic, reproducible retrieval of any OECD dataset via get_dataset()/get_data_structure(); not tourism-specific out of the box but works against OECD's full catalogue including tourism and consumer-confidence series.
why_useful: Generic, scriptable path to OECD tourism/platform-economy tables (e.g. any OECD Tourism Trends & Policies or Digital Economy Outlook series) beyond whatever static OECD consumer-confidence panel we already hold.
last_activity: not confirmed (66 commits total, unclear recency)
duplicate_of_holding: We already hold an OECD consumer confidence panel; this is a generic access method for other OECD tables, not the same data.
themes: Country-level Airbnb studies with shared data: OECD/EU/UN reports with data appendices on platform tourism, Eurostat-Airbnb data-sharing agreement outputs, ECB/IMF papers
why_all: Generic, scriptable path to OECD tourism/platform-economy tables (e.g. any OECD Tourism Trends & Policies or Digital Economy Outlook series) beyond whatever static OECD consumer-confidence panel we already hold.

name: revmng-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server wrapper around the revmng library exposing the same RM decision functions (seat protection, overbooking, pricing, group/LOS, bid prices, charts) as tools for an AI agent. No data, same author/content as revmng.
why_useful: Same methodology value as revmng; only worth separate note because it packages the calculators as callable tools, which could be scripted into a pace/pickup sanity-check pipeline.
themes: Booking-curve / pace / pickup datasets for hotels and STRs (on-the-books, forward bookings), Key Data / Transparent / Lighthouse (OTA Insight) samples, revenue-management forward curves
why_all: Same methodology value as revmng; only worth separate note because it packages the calculators as callable tools, which could be scripted into a pace/pickup sanity-check pipeline.
